# License Exam Question Bank Practice Platform  
## Software Requirements Specification

---

## 1. Introduction

### 1.1 Purpose of the Document
This document aims to define the system design and development details of the **License Exam Question Bank Practice Platform**. It serves as the basis for communication and execution within the development team to ensure that the product's functionality, architecture, and quality meet the specified requirements.

### 1.2 Terminology and Abbreviations
- **FastAPI**: Python high-performance asynchronous backend framework  
- **React**: JavaScript frontend framework  
- **MySQL**: Relational database  
- **GCP**: Google Cloud Platform  
- **Gemini API**: Google AI generation and translation API

---

## 2. System Overview

### 2.1 System Objectives
To build a license exam question bank practice platform similar to examtopic, supporting multiple-choice questions, question bank submissions and review, AI translation and explanations, three practice modes, and learning assistance features.

### 2.2 System Scope
- Supports IT certification questions (originally in English)
- The question bank is collaboratively built by administrators and users; submissions require review
- AI (Gemini API) automatically generates Traditional Chinese translations and detailed explanations, which can be edited by administrators
- Practice modes: specified question bank, random practice, simulated formal exam
- Features: favorites, marking as "unknown," retrying incorrect questions
- Default interface language is Traditional Chinese, with future support for Japanese
- For internal use only, but designed with flexibility for potential public release

---

## 3. System Architecture

### 3.1 Architecture Description
- **Frontend**: React SPA, communicates with FastAPI API
- **Backend**: FastAPI RESTful API, handles business logic, data access, and AI integration
- **Database**: MySQL, supports switching between local Docker and GCP Cloud SQL
- **AI/Translation**: Google Gemini API (Flash 2.5)
- **Deployment**: GCP (Cloud Run, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL)

---

## 4. Functional Requirements

### 4.1 Question Bank Management and Review
- Admins can add, edit, and delete questions
- Regular users can submit questions, subject to admin review
- All questions are multiple-choice (may have multiple correct answers)
- Question fields: English question, options, correct answers, explanations (in English), category
- Chinese translations and explanations are generated by Gemini API and can be edited by admins

### 4.2 AI/Translation Services
- Standardized prompts connect to Gemini API to generate Traditional Chinese translations, correct answers, explanations, and categories
- Admins can manually correct AI-generated content

### 4.3 Practice and Exam Modes
- Practice with specified question bank
- Random practice
- Simulated formal exam (timed, fixed number of questions, results shown after submission)
- Immediate display of answers and explanations after answering (for random/specified practice)
- Simulated exam displays all answers and explanations after submission

### 4.4 Learning Assistance Features
- Favorite questions
- Mark as "unknown"
- Retry incorrect questions

### 4.5 User Management
- Registration, login, role-based permissions (admin/regular user)
- Submitted questions require review

### 4.6 Multilingual Support
- Supports English and Traditional Chinese, with future expansion to Japanese
- No need for interface language switching at this stage

---

## 5. User Interface Design

- Frontend presented as a React SPA with responsive design
- Interfaces for question bank management, review, practice, simulated exams, favorites/marking/retry features
- Immediate display of translations and explanations after answering

---

## 6. Data Structure and Database Design

### 6.1 Main Tables

| Table Name   | Fields |
|--------------|--------|
| users        | id, username, password_hash, role |
| questions    | id, question_en, options_en, answers, explanation_en, category, status, created_by, created_at |
| translations | id, question_id, question_zh, options_zh, explanation_zh, last_modified_by |
| submissions  | id, user_id, question_id, selected_options, is_correct, mode, timestamp |
| favorites    | id, user_id, question_id |
| tags         | id, user_id, question_id, tag_type (e.g., "unknown") |

---

## 7. System Design Details

### 7.1 Environment Switching and Deployment
- Use environment variables to manage database connection info, supporting switching between Docker MySQL (development) and GCP Cloud SQL (production)
- FastAPI connection settings switch automatically based on environment
- Cloud SQL connection recommended via Cloud SQL Auth Proxy

### 7.2 Security and Exception Handling
- JWT authentication, CORS control, HTTPS encryption
- Comprehensive error handling and user notifications
